([[Brown Deer, Wisconsin]]) | college = *{{nowrap|[[North Dakota State College of Science|NDSCS]] (2013–2014)}} *[[Chicago State Cougars men's basketball|Chicago State]] (2014–2017) | draft_year = 2017 | career_start = 2017 | career_end = 2024 | years1 = 2017–2018 | team1 = [[Worcester Wolves]] | years2 = 2018 | team2 = [[Santa Cruz Warriors]] | years3 = 2018–2023 | team3 = [[Motor City Cruise|Northern Arizona Suns / Motor City Cruise]] | years4 = {{nbay|2021|full=y}} | team4 = [[Detroit Pistons]] | years5 = 2024 | team5 = [[Marinos B.B.C.]] | highlights = }} '''Trayvon Palmer''' (born November 13, 1994) is an American former professional [[basketball]] player. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[North Dakota State College of Science]] (NDSCS) and [[Chicago State University]]. ==College career== Palmer played one season of junior college basketball for NDSCS, averaging 13.3 points and 10.1 rebounds per game in the 2013–14 season. He then transferred to [[NCAA Division I]] [[Chicago State Cougars men's basketball|Chicago State]].{{cite web |last1=Kramer |first1=Jesse |title=2014-15 WAC Preview: Who can challenge New Mexico State? |url=http://thecatchandshoot.com/wac-preview-2014-15-preseason/ |website=The Catch and Shoot |access-date=December 30, 2021 |date=October 13, 2014}} He averaged 9.5 points and 7.8 rebounds per game as a junior.{{cite web |title=Chicago State |url=https://madison.com/chicago-state/article_1551263b-881a-5e0d-85eb-3942e3e8e657.html |website=[[Wisconsin State Journal]] |access-date=December 30, 2021 |date=October 20, 2016}} As a senior, Palmer averaged 15.1 points and 9.4 rebounds per game and earned Chicago State's Student-Athlete of the Year honors.{{cite web |last1=Miggins |first1=Corey |title=Trayvon Palmer Inks Deal with Worcester Wolves |url=https://www.gocsucougars.com/news/2017/8/10/mens-basketball-trayvon-palmer-inks-deal-with-worcester-wolves.aspx |website=[[Chicago State Cougars]] |access-date=December 30, 2021 |date=August 10, 2017}} ==Professional career== ===Worcester Wolves (2017–2018)=== Palmer began his professional career in 2017 with the [[Worcester Wolves]] of the [[British Basketball League]].{{cite web|last=Cossali-Francis|first=Marcello|title=Worcester Wolves: ex-forward signs for Detroit Pistons in NBA|url=https://www.worcesternews.co.uk/sport/19813812.worcester-wolves-ex-forward-signs-detroit-pistons-nba/|website=[[Worcester News]]|date=December 29, 2021|access-date=December 29, 2021}}{{cite news |title=Worcester Wolves swoop to sign American prospect Trayvon Palmer from Chicago State University |url=https://www.worcesternews.co.uk/sport/15454874.worcester-wolves-swoop-to-sign-american-prospect-trayvon-palmer-from-chicago-state-university/ |access-date=26 March 2022 |work=[[Worcester News]] |date=4 August 2017}} After a year in England, in which he averaged 14.6 points, 6.0 rebounds and 2.8 assists per game, he returned to the United States. ===Santa Cruz Warriors (2018)=== Palmer joined the [[NBA G League]], signing with the [[Santa Cruz Warriors]] on November 28, 2018.{{cite web |title=Santa Cruz Warriors Acquire Guard Trayvon Palmer |url=https://www.oursportscentral.com/services/releases/santa-cruz-warriors-acquire-guard-trayvon-palmer/n-5423232 |website=Our Sports Central |access-date=December 30, 2021 |date=November 28, 2018}} ===Northern Arizona Suns / Motor City Cruise (2018–2021)=== After averaging 8.5 points and 5.5 rebounds per game in two games, he was acquired by the Northern Arizona Suns in December 2018.{{cite web |last1=Withee |first1=Jake |title=Northern Arizona Suns Acquire Trayvon Palmer |url=https://www.signalsaz.com/articles/northern-arizona-suns-acquire-trayvon-palmer/ |website=Signals AZ |access-date=December 30, 2021 |date=December 18, 2018}} Palmer moved with the team to [[Detroit]] as the team became the [[Motor City Cruise]] in 2021.{{cite web|title=Trayvon Palmer NBA G League profile|url=https://stats.gleague.nba.com/player/1629309/career/|website=[[NBA.com]]|access-date=December 29, 2021}} He averaged 11.1 points and six rebounds per game for the Cruise. ===Detroit Pistons (2021–2022)=== On December 28, 2021, Palmer was signed to a 10-day contract by the [[Detroit Pistons]] of the NBA under league hardship exceptions concerning [[COVID-19]].{{cite web|last=Sankofa II|first=Omari|title=Detroit Pistons sign Trayvon Palmer, Justin Robinson to 10-day contracts|url=https://www.freep.com/story/sports/nba/pistons/2021/12/28/detroit-pistons-roster-trayvon-palmer-justin-robinson-10-day-deals/9037284002/|website=[[Detroit Free Press]]|date=December 28, 2021|access-date=December 29, 2021}} He made his NBA debut the following day in a 94–85 loss to the [[New York Knicks]], grabbing two rebounds.{{cite news |author1=Ben Steele |title=16 minutes and 46 seconds in the NBA: A dream fulfilled for Brown Deer's Trayvon Palmer, but he wants more |url=https://eu.jsonline.com/story/sports/nba/bucks/2022/01/17/trayvon-palmer-went-brown-deer-chicago-state-nba-pistons/6531272001/ |access-date=26 March 2022 |work=[[Milwaukee Journal Sentinel]] |date=17 January 2022}} ===Return to the Cruise (2022–2023)=== On January 3, 2022, Palmer was reassigned to the [[Motor City Cruise]].{{cite news|title=Pistons' Trayvon Palmer: Bound for G League|url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/pistons-trayvon-palmer-bound-for-g-league/|work=[[CBS Sports]]|date=January 3, 2022|access-date=January 6, 2022}} He then was placed there at the expiration of his 10-day contract. ===Marinos de Oriente (2024)=== On February 20, 2024, Palmer signed with the [[Marinos B.B.C.|Marinos de Oriente]] of the [[Superliga Profesional de Baloncesto]].{{cite news|title=TRAVYON PALMER ES EL PRIMER IMPORTADO DE MARINOS DE ORIENTE|url=https://canchalatina.com/2024/02/20/travyon-palmer-es-el-primer-importado-de-marinos-de-oriente/|website=CanchaLatina.com|date=February 20, 2024|access-date=March 10,
